claim.text: An internal root-JSON reader prepares every selected MRK4 MAP granule before returning values, retains complete prefix statistics, and decodes only requested marks with one request budget.
claim.scope: Stock obj_v2_dyn_v2_map_mrk4_s0_variant_basic: eight rows, four two-row marks, exact sixteen-callback root roster. No general root/recursive/public/offline admission.
claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within exact native literals, late checksum, callback-order, detached-prefix, private-stream and calibrated aggregate-budget checks executed
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; other mandatory roots and full 48-cell/public/recursive JSON, remaining types/MV/projections and subsequent performance remain open

risk.boundary: Internal Compact Object callback framing and stream-only EOF preparation
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic staging-reader commit over the advanced phase-split checkpoint; no push or history rewrite.

admitted: Own-file site manifest, framer, role schedule, prepared context, body entry and reader reuse the existing Object/Dynamic/BinaryBulk codecs.
MRK4 named physical extents remain whole callback events and must match the exact parsed prefix/body roster across every mark.
Static sites are keyless; only real Dynamic sites carry Dynamic keys. No Wide registry or saved-pair coordinate rebasing is introduced.
EOF-first validates the full selected-column physical window, prefixes and body framing before publishing prepared state; the cache retains streams/metadata, not ObjectDocument values.
Complete Object and Dynamic statistics bytes and parser-observed offsets are retained; public metadata buffers are detached snapshots.
One implicit request budget covers first-use preparation plus every selected mark; supplied budgets remain cumulative across calls.
Prepared raw streams are not publicly exposed. Budgeted context decoding returns newly decoded documents; direct constructor callers retain explicit no-mutation handoff obligations.
Workspace observers report logical estimates only, not an enforced combined transient ceiling, allocator capacity or RSS.
